body:
GitHub issue #526 (P0-critical, blocks the 1.11.0 release).

PROBLEM
`plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs` is new in 1.11.0 and fails closed (exit 2, deny) when `@adlc/context-handoff` cannot be resolved. Resolution goes through `hooks/handoff-resolve.mjs`, which anchors only on (a) the project root's module resolution and (b) a walk-up from the plugin's own install directory. The ONLY install route the plugin documents is `npm install -g @adlc/cli@latest`, which places the package at `<npm root -g>/@adlc/cli/node_modules/@adlc/context-handoff` - on neither path. A Codex user who follows the README exactly therefore loses every mutating tool call and every shell call for the whole session, with no in-session escape. The identical resolver is used by the Claude Code plugin's handoff gate, so the same lockout is reachable there; the file is pinned byte-identical by `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-drift.test.mjs` and both copies must change together.

Compounding: the printed recovery diagnostic falls back to naming `packages/context-handoff/bin/handoff.mjs`, a path that exists only in a source checkout of this monorepo, and concedes the recovery command is unavailable.

DECISION
Fix by broadening resolution (issue fix direction 1), NOT by failing open on an absent package (direction 2). Fail-closed is the designed posture for this gate and must be preserved: an absent package must not become an evasion route out of an active deny. Once resolution succeeds for the documented install, the recovery diagnostic - which calls the same resolver - names a real absolute path, closing direction 4 as a consequence rather than as a separate change.

BUILD
In `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/handoff-resolve.mjs`, then copy byte-identically to `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/handoff-resolve.mjs`:
1. Add a global-install anchor set, consulted ONLY AFTER the existing project-root and plugin-ancestry anchors so current precedence and trust ordering are unchanged: `NODE_PATH` entries split on the platform path delimiter, plus the npm global root derived from the running interpreter (`<dirname(process.execPath)>/node_modules` for Windows-style prefixes and `<dirname(process.execPath)>/../lib/node_modules` for POSIX prefixes).
2. For each such directory probe both real npm layouts: the hoisted `@adlc/context-handoff` and the nested `@adlc/cli/node_modules/@adlc/context-handoff`, preferring a `createRequire` resolve anchored at the found `package.json` (so package `exports` are honoured) and falling back to a direct `lib/index.mjs` existence check.
3. Keep the resolver pure and execution-free: it must continue to perform only filesystem/module-resolution lookups and must never `import()` the package, because `recoveryDiagnostic` and the recovery-exception path depend on that property.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. With a simulated global npm prefix laid out as `<prefix>/lib/node_modules/@adlc/cli/node_modules/@adlc/context-handoff` and no project-local or plugin-ancestry copy, the resolver returns that entry. Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-global.test.mjs`
2. The hoisted global layout `<prefix>/lib/node_modules/@adlc/context-handoff` also resolves. Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-global.test.mjs`
3. A directory listed in `NODE_PATH` resolves. Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-global.test.mjs`
4. A project-local copy still wins over a global copy - precedence is unchanged. Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-global.test.mjs`
5. With NO copy resolvable anywhere the resolver still returns null and the gate still denies - fail-closed is preserved. Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-global.test.mjs`
6. The Codex copy stays byte-identical to the Claude Code original. Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-drift.test.mjs`
7. The end-to-end hook allows a mutating tool call on a clean repo when the package is reachable only through the simulated global install. Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/handoff-resolve-global-e2e.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none
title: handoff-resolve: resolve @adlc/context-handoff from a global @adlc/cli install
